name: rfp
blurb: Reads a folder of RFP documents and turns them into a pack you import here.

name: draft-microsite
blurb: Builds the client-facing microsite deck in draft state, from the pack this brief exports.

name: publish-microsite
blurb: Promotes a draft deck to the client build — password on, comments stripped, release tagged.

name: report
blurb: The 7-day engagement readout: who opened the deck, what they read, what to do next. Schedules itself when you publish, so you rarely run it by hand.

name: go
blurb: Stands up this site. Run once per team, by whoever owns the repo.

name: push-template
blurb: Pushes template improvements into decks still in draft. Published decks are never touched.
